sentences.text: Minecraft is a sandbox video game created and designed by Swedish game designer Markus `` Notch '' Persson , and later fully developed and published by Mojang .	Mojang	Mojang	sandbox	Sandbox game	video game	video game

The creative and building aspects of Minecraft enable players to build constructions out of textured cubes in a 3D procedurally generated world .	3D	3D computer graphics	procedurally generated	procedural generation
Other activities in the game include exploration , resource gathering , crafting , and combat .

Multiple gameplay modes are available , including a survival mode where the player must acquire resources to build the world and maintain health , a creative mode where players have unlimited resources to build with and the ability to fly , an adventure mode where players can play custom maps created by other players , and a spectator mode where players can fly around and clip through blocks , but can not place or destroy any .	survival	Survival game	survival mode	survival mode	creative mode	#Creative mode	adventure mode	#Adventure mode	maps	Level (video gaming)
The PC version of the game is noted for its modding scene , where a dedicated community creates new gameplay mechanics , items , and assets for the game .	modding scene	Minecraft mods
Minecraft received praise from critics , and won numerous awards and accolades .

, over 121 million copies have been sold across all platforms , making it the second best-selling video game of all time , only behind the various releases of Tetris .	video game	video game	best-selling video game	List of best-selling video games	Tetris	Tetris
